title: Local immutable artifacts and logical state
summary: Own installed package identities, inventory state and desired profiles separately from verified immutable artifact bytes and rebuildable resolved cache. No HTTP transport or live activation is implied by import.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: install_local

output.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

operations.notes: No deadline. Same source under id/version returns existing verified object; another source refuses. Artifact verification/ArtifactStore codes are additional transitive errors.

operations.name: import_artifact

output.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

operations.notes: No deadline. Stages bytes, verifies through install_local and removes staging. Same id/version identity semantics; further verifier errors propagate.

operations.name: fetch

output.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

operations.notes: No deadline; immutable refs and object pins rechecked, underlying store integrity failures also propagate.

operations.name: list_installed
operations.notes: No deadline. Verifies referenced artifacts and enriches installed state with desired and active profile receipts. Store, activation and corruption errors propagate; the exact transitive error set is not closed.

operations.name: set_enabled
operations.notes: No deadline. Same boolean naturally repeats; attached Extension changes require profile route unless trusted allow_attached true.

operations.name: set_pin
operations.notes: No deadline. Repeating the same value naturally preserves it; writes logical inventory state, not immutable package bytes.

operations.name: set_channel
operations.notes: No deadline. Repeating the same value naturally preserves it; writes logical inventory state, not immutable package bytes.

invariants.text: An existing id/version cannot be repointed to different source bytes.
Inventory owns mutable logical state; refs and ArtifactStore own immutable package identity.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

items.description: identity, kind, source_hash, artifact_hash, origin, enabled, pinned_source_hash, channel and profiles. Each profile includes desired extensions and optional activation receipts.
Same installed projection plus parent_luc, version_range and base_source_hash.
